title: Session control / objectives doc (objectives_v0.1)
description: The runtime control plane (ADR 0010): HOW the controller drives the music. Two orthogonal axes (optimize × movement) plus guardrails, Tier-3 constraint bands, and a live loop-doc overlay. The CLAP learner fields (objective, pursue, clap_avoid) were removed with ADR 0031. Standing & complete; editing replaces it and bumps `revision` (re-base on change, CE-R8.2). Supersedes control_objective_v0.1. Rust type: crate::contract::SessionControl. The engine core is I/O-free — the shell/TUI owns watching this file (Phase 1).

revision.description: bumped on every applied edit; recorded in telemetry and each per-loop record

optimize.description: timbre axis: freeze, bounded random drift, or live hand-editing (CE-R8.1)

constraints.description: Tier-3 runtime constraint bands (native units), JSONPath -> {min,max}. If a param sits outside its band, the controller drives it back at <= max_change (Phase 1 attractor).

overrides.description: live loop-doc overlay: JSONPath -> value (number/bool/string), merged onto the operating point at the next loop boundary (Phase 1).

movement.description: musical-movement axis: generative Orrery harmony on/off + its config. `tension_max`/`voice_changes_per_loop`/`home` are parsed but inert until Phase 5; `bind` is fully consumed in Phase 4.

bind.description: which note modulators Orrery drives (by id); defaults match the demo fixtures

phrase_loops.description: loops per phrase (how often a chord change happens)

tension_max.description: INERT until Phase 5: exceeding it triggers a global return home

voice_changes_per_loop.description: INERT until Phase 5: 4-loop moving-average sparseness band

arrange.description: Phase 6d: optional Arranger tuning. Every field defaults to the engine's built-in constant, so an absent/partial block renders byte-identically. The full per-track hazard table stays internal.

arp_density.description: arp euclid-density band as a FRACTION of the arp's authored length (min/max 0..1, default 0.12..0.70); pulses interpolate across [min·len, max·len] by the energy/tension drive

return_hazard_scale.description: multiplier on every return-home hazard (chord + per-track); >1 returns home sooner, <1 wanders longer; applied atop the Arranger's build/release return_scale

guardrails.description: max_change_per_loop bounds every drift step; floors/ceilings tighten the Tier-2 safe range.
